authority: existing protected local bearer/no-Origin middleware; genuine sealed private binding; actual current ProjectStore registry and committed private session reference
behavior: original prompt-record read only; no current engine/transcript/status inference, mutation, replay, new original or adoption of old engine/service epoch
canonicalHash: original LocalOperationRequest serialized by Native serde_json, as captured before the actual prompt effect; hash is checked again at lookup

states.uncertain: Intent/Uncertain persist admission=uncertain,state=unknown; keep UI locked

absent: None proves only absence of a matching retained record, never unsent/rejected or permission to replay
legacyOrMixedOwner: refuse; do not fabricate LocalPromptOriginal for old ownerless or Project records
gateway: Root finite allowlist only; no wildcard proxy, caller-selected upstream method/URL/headers or new credential
